1	---
     2	name: ui-plugin-development
     3	description: Inspect or customize UI Plugins; implement a new Plugin or new behavior only after a direct user commission, satisfied conditional commission, or approval of a bound development proposal.
     4	compatibility: Agent UI Plugin Creator Phase 8 permits writes under project plugins and AppUIModel composition.
     5	allowed-tools: enable_creator_tools takeover_plugin_source prepare_plugin_responsive_repair ask_user_question read_file ls glob grep edit_file prepare_ui_plugin_development create_ui_plugin mutate_ui_plugin_source prepare_ui_service_contract_change create_ui_service_contract mutate_ui_service_contract inspect_ui_capabilities inspect_ui_plugin_delivery inspect_ui_project inspect_app_ui_model inspect_ui_slots list_ui_plugins inspect_ui_plugin preflight_ui_plugin_placement inspect_ui_services inspect_ui_plugin_source_references inspect_agent_ui_sources apply_agent_ui_source_item mutate_app_ui_model validate_creator_changes
     6	---
     7	
     8	# UI Plugin development
     9	
    10	This Skill applies to frontend Plugin source/application authoring. The system
    11	prompt owns general evidence, authorization and completion rules; this Skill
    12	adds Plugin-specific contracts, not an additional investigation checklist.
    13	Use the smallest relevant section/reference. A resolved existing target does not
    14	require a full capability inventory, a new UI-system decision or a nearest
    15	consumer example before it can be modified.
    16	
    17	## Ownership and admission
    18	
    19	Project-owned application props, children, renderers and scoped styles are ordinary
    20	editable code. Inspect the exact target and any concrete unknown contract; edit
    21	within the user's request. Public npm component use does not require implementation
    22	source, extraction or takeover. Existing source-owned Plugin edits keep the current
    23	ownership, upstream provenance and BASE; do not repeat successful takeover consent.
    24	Only actual npm implementation edits require `takeover_plugin_source` and its
    25	explicit user agreement. Runtime, shared Context, vendor and generated registries
    26	remain protected. A thin wrapper's omitted public seam is not justification for
    27	requiring takeover.
    28	
    29	Before first new Plugin source or new business behavior, the Host must authorize
    30	the bounded `prepare_ui_plugin_development` plan. Direct commissions, satisfied
    31	conditional commissions and approved proposals retain their specific semantics;
    32	a Skill or inspection does not grant development permission. A normal existing
    33	Plugin customization does not need a new development approval. For a genuinely new
    34	Plugin, consult [authoring contracts](references/authoring-contracts.md) for admission,
    35	manifest/placement, Service/data and delivery obligations. For a new visual Plugin
    36	or actual UI-system choice also consult [UI selection](references/default-ui-composition.md).
    37	Do not load new-Plugin investigation requirements for a local presentation repair.
    38	
    39	## Local change evidence
    40	
    41	Read the existing files that will change, using the actual supplied sourceRoot and
    42	owner paths. `manifest.json` declares identity/data/capabilities; `definition.ts`
    43	joins manifest and component; `index.tsx` owns composition/behavior; imported
    44	stylesheets own presentation. Read a neighboring consumer only for wiring that
    45	is actually unknown. An npm implementation need not appear in local search.
    46	
    47	`inspect_ui_plugin` returns application ownership, public APIs and parent semantic
    48	composition where declared. sharedModule selects the installed public module;
    49	use the root module for presentation controls and /plugin-support for shared types.
    50	Use returned parameterContracts; follow exact parameterQueries only when a required
    51	signature is missing. `$element` accesses an array/index element, not React props.

steps.question: 是否将插件 composer 的源码交给当前工程托管？
steps.description:
接管后，当前版本的源码会保存到你的工程中，由你维护。插件配置保持不变。

升级 npm 包不会覆盖或自动更新这份源码；需要新功能时，可以让 Creator 协助同步。

共享依赖仍通过 npm 提供，升级或同步后需要检查兼容性。

options.label: 同意，转为工程源码托管
